replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
It is rather flat and there's not much space to allow tunneling, the monuments are too close to spawn, and seem impossible to get. My recommendation here would be to relocate monuments (making them not that hard to get) and to add more space to the map itself.
The map has a lot of potential, so if you could improve it and add more stuff it would be splendid :)
Thanks for submitting your map!
